newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - NAB sees more growth in non-banking.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - NAB sees more growth in non-banking.

text.p: National Bank Bank Ltd (NAB) managing director Don Argus said on Thursday that he expects its Australian fee income business to continue to grow in the future.

"They are now becoming a very integral part of the future organisation and they are now starting to contribute quite well and I would expect the trend will continue," Argus told reporters after the release of the bank's annual results.
NAB's unit National Australia Financial Management reported a 38.9 percent rise in operating profit to A$25 million in the year to September 30, 1996.
NAB earlier reported a 6.8 percent increase in net profit to A$2.1 billion for the year to September 30, 1996, its fourth consecutive annual record profit.
NAB's fledgling U.K. insurance business, National Australia Ltd, was expected to become profitable in about two year time, Argus said.
"It's now fully operational and whilst it's not profitable yet, it probably in about another two years (will) be into the black," he said.
